lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: Does a citizen have the legal right to video record a police traffic stop in Texas?

options.text: No, recording police officers is classified as a third-degree state felony
Only if the officer signs a written consent waiver prior to the interaction
Recording is permitted exclusively during daylight hours in public park zones
Yes, provided the recording does not physically interfere with officer duties
